use_cases: Creating an animated hero section backdrop with ambient light beams
Adding visual depth to dark-themed landing pages
Enhancing product showcases with subtle pulsing gradients
Providing decorative backgrounds for SaaS marketing pages
Creating atmospheric effects for media and entertainment sites
ai_summary: BeamsBackground is a canvas-based animated background component that renders continuously pulsing, translucent beams with gradient coloring. The component supports dark mode detection, three intensity levels (subtle, medium, strong), and uses requestAnimationFrame for smooth 60fps animation. Each beam has randomized properties including position, angle, speed, hue, and pulse behavior to create a dynamic, ambient light effect suitable for hero sections or decorative backgrounds.
